|---|---|

| **Latency Sweet Spot** | <4.2 ms primary target; 4.6–4.7 ms acceptable only for ≥89.5% accuracy. |
| **Accuracy Ceiling** | 89.60% (ID 2); diminishing returns beyond 4.2 ms for 1–2% accuracy gains. |
| **Avoid Patterns** | (1) op=0 at position 2, (2) op=4 anywhere, (3) op=2 or op=4 at position 5, (4) op=3 at position 0 unless accuracy >89.5%. |
